-- This is auto-generated code
SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://storageaccount069.dfs.core.windows.net/source/csvfile/Students Social Media Addiction.csv',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW= TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.SocialMediaUsage
(
    Student_ID INT,
    Age INT,
    Gender VARCHAR(10),
    Academic_Level VARCHAR(50),
    Country VARCHAR(50),
    Avg_Daily_Usage_Hours FLOAT,
    Most_Used_Platform VARCHAR(50),
    Affects_Academic_Performance VARCHAR(5),
    Sleep_Hours_Per_Night FLOAT,
    Mental_Health_Score INT,
    Relationship_Status VARCHAR(30),
    Conflicts_Over_Social_Media INT,
    Addicted_Score INT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://storageaccount069.dfs.core.windows.net/source/csvfile/Students Social Media Addiction.csv',  -- folder path inside container
    DATA_SOURCE = MyDataSource,
    FILE_FORMAT = MyCSVFormat
);

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE MyDataSource
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://storageaccount069.dfs.core.windows.net/source'
);

create DATABASE ADLS

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT MyCSVFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2
    )
);

select * from dbo.SocialMediaUsage
